name: carrier_watch
_comment: Wave 5, B NPC carrier: the player (Kit Lancer, 30000 shield, recharging, no weapons) sits at Kit Carrier Port (sÿst 2004) where ordinary traffic is ONE AI 3 Kit Bomb Carrier of the always-attacks gövt 362 (bay of 4 Kit Bombers, each firing the 400 px blast shell). Does it launch its bombers, and does a bomber blast near the carrier turn the carrier on the bomber? Tab every 3.3 s cycles through the ships (target panel: name, shield/armor). 110 s recorded. Pilot w5_carrier.
